use super::*;
use crate::protocol::admin::{
    decode_describe_topic_partitions_request, encode_describe_topic_partitions_response,
};
use crate::protocol::api::{encode_api_versions_response, ApiVersion, ApiVersionsResponse};
use crate::protocol::header::{decode_request_header, encode_response_header, RequestHeader};
use bytes::{Bytes, BytesMut};
use tokio::io::{AsyncReadExt, AsyncWriteExt};
use tokio::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream};

async fn admin_and_listener() -> (Admin, TcpListener) {
    let listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
    let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap().to_string();
    let conn = BrokerConn::connect(&addr, "dtp-test", Duration::from_secs(5))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let mut admin = Admin::test_holding(conn);
    admin.describe_topic_partitions_version = Some(0);
    (admin, listener)
}

async fn request(socket: &mut TcpStream) -> (RequestHeader, Bytes) {
    let len = usize::try_from(socket.read_i32().await.unwrap()).unwrap();
    assert!(len < 1024 * 1024);
    let mut data = vec![0; len];
    let _read = socket.read_exact(&mut data).await.unwrap();
    let mut body = Bytes::from(data);
    let header = decode_request_header(&mut body).unwrap();
    (header, body)
}

async fn dtp_request(socket: &mut TcpStream, expected: Option<(&str, i32)>) -> RequestHeader {
    let (header, mut body) = request(socket).await;
    assert_eq!(
        (header.api_key, header.api_version),
        (DESCRIBE_TOPIC_PARTITIONS, 0)
    );
    let (names, limit, cursor) = decode_describe_topic_partitions_request(&mut body).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(names, vec!["orders"]);
    assert_eq!(limit, 1);
    assert_eq!(
        cursor
            .as_ref()
            .map(|c| (c.topic_name.as_str(), c.partition_index)),
        expected
    );
    assert!(body.is_empty());
    header
}

fn page(partition: i32, next: Option<(&str, i32)>) -> DescribeTopicPartitionsResponse {
    let mut part = DescribedTopicPartition::new(0);
    part.partition_index = partition;
    part.leader_id = 1;
    let mut topic = DescribedTopicPartitions::new("orders", 0);
    topic.topic_id = [7; 16];
    topic.partitions = vec![part];
    topic.topic_authorized_operations = 37;
    let mut response = DescribeTopicPartitionsResponse::new(vec![topic]);
    response.next_cursor = next.map(|(name, index)| TopicPartitionCursor::new(name, index));
    response
}

async fn send_page(
    socket: &mut TcpStream,
    header: &RequestHeader,
    response: &DescribeTopicPartitionsResponse,
) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let mut body = BytesMut::new();
    encode_response_header(
        &mut body,
        header.api_key,
        header.api_version,
        header.correlation_id,
    )
    .unwrap();
    encode_describe_topic_partitions_response(&mut body, response).unwrap();
    socket.write_i32(i32::try_from(body.len()).unwrap()).await?;
    socket.write_all(&body).await
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn dtp_pagination_accumulates_complete_pages() {
    let (mut admin, listener) = admin_and_listener().await;
    let peer = tokio::spawn(async move {
        let (mut socket, _) = listener.accept().await.unwrap();
        let first = dtp_request(&mut socket, None).await;
        send_page(&mut socket, &first, &page(0, Some(("orders", 1))))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let second = dtp_request(&mut socket, Some(("orders", 1))).await;
        send_page(&mut socket, &second, &page(1, None))
            .await
            .unwrap();
    });
    let names = ["orders"];
    let result = admin
        .describe_topics_with_partition_limit_timeout(names.iter(), true, 1, Duration::from_secs(5))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(result.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(result[0].name(), "orders");
    assert_eq!(result[0].topic_id(), Uuid::from([7; 16]));
    assert_eq!(result[0].authorized_operations(), 37);
    assert_eq!(
        result[0]
            .partitions()
            .iter()
            .map(|p| p.partition)
            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
        vec![0, 1]
    );
    peer.await.unwrap();
}

async fn repeated_cursor_case(cycle: bool) {
    let (mut admin, listener) = admin_and_listener().await;
    let peer = tokio::spawn(async move {
        let (mut socket, _) = listener.accept().await.unwrap();
        let first = dtp_request(&mut socket, None).await;
        send_page(&mut socket, &first, &page(0, Some(("orders", 1))))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let second = dtp_request(&mut socket, Some(("orders", 1))).await;
        let next = if cycle { 2 } else { 1 };
        send_page(&mut socket, &second, &page(1, Some(("orders", next))))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        if cycle {
            let third = dtp_request(&mut socket, Some(("orders", 2))).await;
            send_page(&mut socket, &third, &page(2, Some(("orders", 1))))
                .await
                .unwrap();
        }
    });
    let names = ["orders"];
    let got = admin
        .describe_topics_with_partition_limit_timeout(
            names.iter(),
            false,
            1,
            Duration::from_secs(5),
        )
        .await;
    assert!(matches!(got, Err(Error::Protocol(_))), "got {got:?}");
    peer.await.unwrap();
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn dtp_pagination_rejects_an_immediate_repeat() {
    repeated_cursor_case(false).await;
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn dtp_pagination_nonadjacent_cycle_times_out_without_partial_result() {
    let (mut admin, listener) = admin_and_listener().await;
    let (fourth_tx, fourth_rx) = tokio::sync::oneshot::channel();
    let (release_tx, release_rx) = tokio::sync::oneshot::channel();
    let peer = tokio::spawn(async move {
        let (mut socket, _) = listener.accept().await.unwrap();
        let first = dtp_request(&mut socket, None).await;
        send_page(&mut socket, &first, &page(0, Some(("orders", 1))))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let second = dtp_request(&mut socket, Some(("orders", 1))).await;
        send_page(&mut socket, &second, &page(1, Some(("orders", 2))))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let third = dtp_request(&mut socket, Some(("orders", 2))).await;
        send_page(&mut socket, &third, &page(2, Some(("orders", 1))))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let _fourth = dtp_request(&mut socket, Some(("orders", 1))).await;
        fourth_tx.send(()).unwrap();
        release_rx.await.unwrap();
    });
    let names = ["orders"];
    let mut call = Box::pin(admin.describe_topics_with_partition_limit_timeout(
        names.iter(),
        false,
        1,
        Duration::from_secs(1),
    ));
    tokio::select! {
        result = &mut call => panic!("finished before the fourth request: {result:?}"),
        got = fourth_rx => got.unwrap(),
    }
    let result = call.await;
    assert!(matches!(result, Err(Error::Timeout)), "got {result:?}");
    release_tx.send(()).unwrap();
    peer.await.unwrap();
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn dtp_pagination_rejects_oversized_timeout_without_panicking() {
    let (mut admin, _listener) = admin_and_listener().await;
    let names = ["orders"];
    let got = admin
        .describe_topics_with_partition_limit_timeout(names.iter(), false, 1, Duration::MAX)
        .await;
    assert!(matches!(got, Err(Error::Timeout)), "got {got:?}");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn dtp_pagination_deadline_retires_inflight_socket_and_reconnects() {
    let (mut admin, listener) = admin_and_listener().await;
    let (second_tx, second_rx) = tokio::sync::oneshot::channel();
    let (late_tx, late_rx) = tokio::sync::oneshot::channel();
    let peer = tokio::spawn(async move {
        let (mut old, _) = listener.accept().await.unwrap();
        let first = dtp_request(&mut old, None).await;
        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1200)).await;
        send_page(&mut old, &first, &page(0, Some(("orders", 1))))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let second = dtp_request(&mut old, Some(("orders", 1))).await;
        second_tx.send(()).unwrap();
        late_rx.await.unwrap();
        let _late_write = send_page(&mut old, &second, &page(999, None)).await;

        let (mut new, _) = listener.accept().await.unwrap();
        let (versions_header, _) = request(&mut new).await;
        assert_eq!(versions_header.api_key, API_VERSIONS);
        let versions = ApiVersionsResponse {
            api_keys: vec![
                ApiVersion {
                    api_key: METADATA,
                    min_version: 0,
                    max_version: 12,
                },
                ApiVersion {
                    api_key: DESCRIBE_TOPIC_PARTITIONS,
                    min_version: 0,
                    max_version: 0,
                },
            ],
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let mut body = BytesMut::new();
        encode_response_header(
            &mut body,
            versions_header.api_key,
            versions_header.api_version,
            versions_header.correlation_id,
        )
        .unwrap();
        encode_api_versions_response(&mut body, versions_header.api_version, &versions).unwrap();
        new.write_i32(i32::try_from(body.len()).unwrap())
            .await
            .unwrap();
        new.write_all(&body).await.unwrap();
        let retry = dtp_request(&mut new, None).await;
        send_page(&mut new, &retry, &page(42, None)).await.unwrap();
    });
    let names = ["orders"];
    let mut call = Box::pin(admin.describe_topics_with_partition_limit_timeout(
        names.iter(),
        false,
        1,
        Duration::from_secs(2),
    ));
    tokio::select! {
        got = &mut call => panic!("finished before second page: {got:?}"),
        got = second_rx => got.unwrap(),
    }
    let got = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_millis(1400), &mut call)
        .await
        .expect("the second page reset the shared deadline");
    assert!(matches!(got, Err(Error::Timeout)), "got {got:?}");
    drop(call);
    assert!(
        admin.conn.is_closed(),
        "timed out connection was not retired"
    );
    late_tx.send(()).unwrap();
    let retry = admin
        .describe_topic_partitions_timeout(&["orders"], 1, None, Duration::from_secs(5))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(retry.topics[0].partitions[0].partition_index, 42);
    assert!(retry.next_cursor.is_none());
    peer.await.unwrap();
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn dtp_raw_request_preserves_next_cursor_and_rejects_zero_timeout() {
    let (mut admin, listener) = admin_and_listener().await;
    let got = admin
        .describe_topic_partitions_timeout(&["orders"], 1, None, Duration::ZERO)
        .await;
    assert!(matches!(got, Err(Error::Timeout)), "got {got:?}");
    let peer = tokio::spawn(async move {
        let (mut socket, _) = listener.accept().await.unwrap();
        let header = dtp_request(&mut socket, None).await;
        send_page(&mut socket, &header, &page(0, Some(("orders", 1))))
            .await
            .unwrap();
    });
    let result = admin
        .describe_topic_partitions_timeout(&["orders"], 1, None, Duration::from_secs(5))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        result.next_cursor,
        Some(TopicPartitionCursor::new("orders", 1))
    );
    peer.await.unwrap();
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn dtp_raw_cancel_during_encoding_keeps_socket_usable() {
    use std::future::Future;

    let (mut admin, listener) = admin_and_listener().await;
    let names = vec!["orders"; 8193];
    let mut call =
        Box::pin(admin.describe_topic_partitions_timeout(&names, 1, None, Duration::from_secs(5)));
    std::future::poll_fn(|cx| {
        assert!(call.as_mut().poll(cx).is_pending());
        std::task::Poll::Ready(())
    })
    .await;
    drop(call);
    assert!(
        !admin.conn.is_closed(),
        "encoding cancellation retired an idle socket"
    );
    let peer = tokio::spawn(async move {
        let (mut socket, _) = listener.accept().await.unwrap();
        let header = dtp_request(&mut socket, None).await;
        send_page(&mut socket, &header, &page(42, None))
            .await
            .unwrap();
    });
    let result = admin
        .describe_topic_partitions_timeout(&["orders"], 1, None, Duration::from_secs(5))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(result.topics[0].partitions[0].partition_index, 42);
    peer.await.unwrap();
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn dtp_raw_cancel_after_request_retires_socket() {
    let (mut admin, listener) = admin_and_listener().await;
    let (ready_tx, ready_rx) = tokio::sync::oneshot::channel();
    let (release_tx, release_rx) = tokio::sync::oneshot::channel();
    let peer = tokio::spawn(async move {
        let (mut socket, _) = listener.accept().await.unwrap();
        let header = dtp_request(&mut socket, None).await;
        ready_tx.send(()).unwrap();
        release_rx.await.unwrap();
        let _late = send_page(&mut socket, &header, &page(9, None)).await;
    });
    let names = ["orders"];
    let mut call =
        Box::pin(admin.describe_topic_partitions_timeout(&names, 1, None, Duration::from_secs(5)));
    tokio::select! {
        got = &mut call => panic!("finished before cancellation: {got:?}"),
        got = ready_rx => got.unwrap(),
    }
    drop(call);
    assert!(
        admin.conn.is_closed(),
        "inflight cancellation kept the socket usable"
    );
    release_tx.send(()).unwrap();
    peer.await.unwrap();
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn dtp_raw_unsupported_precedes_zero_and_oversized_timeout() {
    let (mut admin, _listener) = admin_and_listener().await;
    admin.describe_topic_partitions_version = None;
    for duration in [Duration::ZERO, Duration::MAX] {
        let got = admin
            .describe_topic_partitions_timeout(&["orders"], 1, None, duration)
            .await;
        assert!(matches!(got, Err(Error::Unsupported(_))), "got {got:?}");
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn dtp_empty_describe_stays_a_noop_at_extreme_timeouts() {
    let (mut admin, _listener) = admin_and_listener().await;
    let names: [&str; 0] = [];
    for duration in [Duration::ZERO, Duration::MAX] {
        let got = admin
            .describe_topics_with_partition_limit_timeout(names.iter(), false, 1, duration)
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert!(got.is_empty());
    }
}

async fn pagination_bench(pages: i32, iterations: usize) {
    let (mut admin, listener) = admin_and_listener().await;
    let peer = tokio::spawn(async move {
        let (mut socket, _) = listener.accept().await.unwrap();
        socket.set_nodelay(true).unwrap();
        for _ in 0..iterations {
            for index in 0..pages {
                let expected = if index == 0 { None } else { Some(("orders", index)) };
                let header = dtp_request(&mut socket, expected).await;
                let next = if index + 1 == pages { None } else { Some(("orders", index + 1)) };
                send_page(&mut socket, &header, &page(index, next)).await.unwrap();
            }
        }
    });
    let names = ["orders"];
    let start = std::time::Instant::now();
    for _ in 0..iterations {
        let got = admin
            .describe_topics_with_partition_limit_timeout(names.iter(), false, 1, Duration::from_secs(5))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(got.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(got[0].partitions().len(), usize::try_from(pages).unwrap());
        assert_eq!(got[0].partitions().first().map(|x| x.partition), Some(0));
        assert_eq!(got[0].partitions().last().map(|x| x.partition), Some(pages - 1));
    }
    let elapsed = start.elapsed().as_nanos();
    peer.await.unwrap();
    println!("MEASURE pages={pages} iterations={iterations} elapsed_ns={elapsed}");
}

#[tokio::test]
#[ignore = "manual matched loopback diagnostic"]

    pagination_bench(1, 4000).await;
}

#[tokio::test]
#[ignore = "manual matched loopback diagnostic"]
async fn dtp_pagination_benchmark_many_pages() {
    pagination_bench(16, 250).await;
}

async fn dtp_requested_name_bench(topic_count: usize, iterations: usize, reverse: bool, lexical: bool, success: bool) {
    let (mut admin, listener) = admin_and_listener().await;
    let names: Vec<String> = (0..topic_count).map(|n| format!("topic-{n}")).collect();
    let peer_names = names.clone();
    let limit = if success { i32::try_from(topic_count).unwrap() } else { 1 };
    let peer = tokio::spawn(async move {
        let (mut socket, _) = listener.accept().await.unwrap();
        socket.set_nodelay(true).unwrap();
        let mut topics: Vec<_> = peer_names
            .iter()
            .map(|name| {
                let error = if success { 0 } else { crate::error::UNKNOWN_TOPIC_OR_PARTITION };
                let mut topic = DescribedTopicPartitions::new(name.as_str(), error);
                if success {
                    let mut partition = DescribedTopicPartition::new(0);
                    partition.leader_id = 1;
                    topic.partitions.push(partition);
                }
                topic
            })
            .collect();
        if reverse {
            topics.reverse();
        } else if lexical {
            topics.sort_by(|left, right| left.name.cmp(&right.name));
        }
        let response = DescribeTopicPartitionsResponse::new(topics);
        for _ in 0..iterations {
            let (header, mut body) = request(&mut socket).await;
            assert_eq!((header.api_key, header.api_version), (DESCRIBE_TOPIC_PARTITIONS, 0));
            let (got, limit, cursor) = decode_describe_topic_partitions_request(&mut body).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(got, peer_names);
            assert_eq!(limit, if success { i32::try_from(topic_count).unwrap() } else { 1 });
            assert!(cursor.is_none());
            assert!(body.is_empty());
            send_page(&mut socket, &header, &response).await.unwrap();
        }
    });
    let started = std::time::Instant::now();
    for _ in 0..iterations {
        let descriptions = admin
            .describe_topics_with_partition_limit_timeout(
                names.iter(),
                false,
                limit,
                Duration::from_secs(5),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(descriptions.len(), topic_count);
        if success {
            assert!(descriptions.iter().all(|topic| topic.error_code() == 0 && topic.partitions().len() == 1));
        } else {
            assert!(descriptions.iter().all(|topic| topic.error_code() == crate::error::UNKNOWN_TOPIC_OR_PARTITION));
        }
    }
    let elapsed = started.elapsed().as_nanos();
    peer.await.unwrap();
    println!("MEASURE names={topic_count} iterations={iterations} elapsed_ns={elapsed}");
}

#[ignore = "manual matched loopback diagnostic"]
async fn dtp_requested_name_benchmark_four() {
    dtp_requested_name_bench(4, 2_000, false, false, false).await;
}

#[tokio::test]
#[ignore = "manual matched loopback diagnostic"]
async fn dtp_requested_name_benchmark_many_names_pages() {
    let iterations = 250;
    let (mut admin, listener) = admin_and_listener().await;
    let names: Vec<String> = (0..32).map(|n| format!("topic-{n}")).collect();
    let peer_names = names.clone();
    let peer = tokio::spawn(async move {
        let (mut socket, _) = listener.accept().await.unwrap();
        socket.set_nodelay(true).unwrap();
        let topic = |name: &str, partition| {
            let mut value = page(partition, None).topics.pop().unwrap();
            value.name = Some(name.to_owned());
            value
        };
        let first = peer_names[..16].iter().map(|n| topic(n, 0)).collect();
        let mut second = vec![topic(&peer_names[15], 1)];
        second.extend(peer_names[16..31].iter().map(|n| topic(n, 0)));
        let third = vec![topic(&peer_names[31], 0)];
        let mut first = DescribeTopicPartitionsResponse::new(first);
        first.next_cursor = Some(TopicPartitionCursor::new(peer_names[15].as_str(), 1));
        let mut second = DescribeTopicPartitionsResponse::new(second);
        second.next_cursor = Some(TopicPartitionCursor::new(peer_names[31].as_str(), 0));
        let third = DescribeTopicPartitionsResponse::new(third);
        let responses = [first, second, third];
        for _ in 0..iterations {
            for (page_index, response) in responses.iter().enumerate() {
                let (header, mut body) = request(&mut socket).await;
                assert_eq!((header.api_key, header.api_version), (DESCRIBE_TOPIC_PARTITIONS, 0));
                let (got, limit, cursor) = decode_describe_topic_partitions_request(&mut body).unwrap();
                assert_eq!(got, peer_names);
                assert_eq!(limit, 16);
                let expected = match page_index {
                    0 => None,
                    1 => Some((peer_names[15].as_str(), 1)),
                    _ => Some((peer_names[31].as_str(), 0)),
                };
                assert_eq!(cursor.as_ref().map(|c| (c.topic_name.as_str(), c.partition_index)), expected);
                assert!(body.is_empty());
                send_page(&mut socket, &header, response).await.unwrap();
            }
        }
    });
    let started = std::time::Instant::now();
    for _ in 0..iterations {
        let descriptions = admin
            .describe_topics_with_partition_limit_timeout(names.iter(), false, 16, Duration::from_secs(5))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(descriptions.len(), 32);
        assert!(descriptions.iter().all(|topic| topic.error_code() == 0));
        assert_eq!(descriptions[15].partitions().len(), 2);
        assert_eq!(descriptions[31].partitions().len(), 1);
    }
    let elapsed = started.elapsed().as_nanos();
    peer.await.unwrap();
    println!("MEASURE names=32 pages=3 iterations={iterations} elapsed_ns={elapsed}");
}

// Run against the same broker script for each source arm. The script would
// progress after A -> B -> A; the candidate returns before the fourth page.
#[tokio::test]
async fn dtp_transient_repeat_qualification() {
    let expect_candidate = std::env::var("DTP_QUALIFICATION_ARM").unwrap() == "candidate";
    let (mut admin, listener) = admin_and_listener().await;
    let peer = tokio::spawn(async move {
        let (mut socket, _) = listener.accept().await.unwrap();
        let first = dtp_request(&mut socket, None).await;
        send_page(&mut socket, &first, &page(0, Some(("orders", 1)))).await.unwrap();
        let second = dtp_request(&mut socket, Some(("orders", 1))).await;
        send_page(&mut socket, &second, &page(1, Some(("orders", 2)))).await.unwrap();
        let third = dtp_request(&mut socket, Some(("orders", 2))).await;
        send_page(&mut socket, &third, &page(2, Some(("orders", 1)))).await.unwrap();
        if expect_candidate {
            let raw = dtp_request(&mut socket, None).await;
            send_page(&mut socket, &raw, &page(42, None)).await.unwrap();
        } else {
            let fourth = dtp_request(&mut socket, Some(("orders", 1))).await;
            send_page(&mut socket, &fourth, &page(3, Some(("orders", 3)))).await.unwrap();
            let fifth = dtp_request(&mut socket, Some(("orders", 3))).await;
            send_page(&mut socket, &fifth, &page(4, None)).await.unwrap();
        }
    });
    let names = ["orders"];
    let result = admin.describe_topics_with_partition_limit_timeout(
        names.iter(), false, 1, Duration::from_secs(10)
    ).await;
    if expect_candidate {
        assert!(matches!(&result, Err(Error::Protocol(msg)) if msg == "repeated DescribeTopicPartitions cursor"), "{result:?}");
        let raw = admin.describe_topic_partitions_timeout(&names, 1, None, Duration::from_secs(10)).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(raw.topics[0].partitions[0].partition_index, 42);
        println!("TRANSIENT arm=candidate result=protocol_error pages_read=3 raw_socket_reused=true");
    } else {
        let rows = result.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(rows.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(rows[0].name(), "orders");
        assert_eq!(rows[0].partitions().iter().map(|p| p.partition).collect::<Vec<_>>(), vec![0,1,2,3,4]);
        println!("TRANSIENT arm=baseline result=success pages_read=5");
    }
    peer.await.unwrap();
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn dtp_cursor_future_size_qualification() {
    let (mut admin, _listener) = admin_and_listener().await;
    let names = ["orders"];
    let aggregate = admin.describe_topics_with_partition_limit_timeout(
        names.iter(), false, 1, Duration::from_secs(5)
    );
    fn require_send<T: Send>(_: &T) {}
    require_send(&aggregate);
    let aggregate_bytes = std::mem::size_of_val(&aggregate);
    drop(aggregate);
    let raw = admin.describe_topic_partitions_timeout(&names, 1, None, Duration::from_secs(5));
    let raw_bytes = std::mem::size_of_val(&raw);
    drop(raw);
    println!("FUTURE_SIZE aggregate_bytes={aggregate_bytes} raw_bytes={raw_bytes} usize_bytes={}", std::mem::size_of::<usize>());
}

#[tokio::test]
#[ignore = "manual matched loopback diagnostic"]
async fn dtp_cursor_benchmark_two_pages() {
    pagination_bench(2, 2_000).await;
}

#[tokio::test]
#[ignore = "manual matched loopback diagnostic"]
async fn dtp_cursor_benchmark_long_names() {
    let pages = 16usize;
    let iterations = 250usize;
    let (mut admin, listener) = admin_and_listener().await;
    let names: Vec<String> = (0..pages).map(|i| format!("{}{:02}", "x".repeat(246), i)).collect();
    assert!(names.iter().all(|name| name.len() == 248));
    let peer_names = names.clone();
    let peer = tokio::spawn(async move {
        let (mut socket, _) = listener.accept().await.unwrap();
        socket.set_nodelay(true).unwrap();
        for _ in 0..iterations {
            for index in 0..pages {
                let (header, mut body) = request(&mut socket).await;
                assert_eq!((header.api_key, header.api_version), (DESCRIBE_TOPIC_PARTITIONS, 0));
                let (requested, limit, cursor) = decode_describe_topic_partitions_request(&mut body).unwrap();
                assert_eq!(requested, peer_names);
                assert_eq!(limit, 1);
                let expected = if index == 0 { None } else { Some((peer_names[index].as_str(), 0)) };
                assert_eq!(cursor.as_ref().map(|c| (c.topic_name.as_str(), c.partition_index)), expected);
                assert!(body.is_empty());
                let mut part = DescribedTopicPartition::new(0);
                part.partition_index = 0;
                part.leader_id = 1;
                let mut topic = DescribedTopicPartitions::new(peer_names[index].as_str(), 0);
                topic.topic_id = [u8::try_from(index + 1).unwrap(); 16];
                topic.partitions.push(part);
                let mut response = DescribeTopicPartitionsResponse::new(vec![topic]);
                if let Some(next) = peer_names.get(index + 1) {
                    response.next_cursor = Some(TopicPartitionCursor::new(next.as_str(), 0));
                }
                send_page(&mut socket, &header, &response).await.unwrap();
            }
        }
    });
    let start = std::time::Instant::now();
    for _ in 0..iterations {
        let got = admin.describe_topics_with_partition_limit_timeout(
            names.iter(), false, 1, Duration::from_secs(10)
        ).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(got.len(), pages);
        for (row, name) in got.iter().zip(names.iter()) {
            assert_eq!(row.name(), name);
            assert_eq!(row.error_code(), 0);
            assert_eq!(row.partitions().len(), 1);
            assert_eq!(row.partitions()[0].partition, 0);
        }
    }
    let elapsed = start.elapsed().as_nanos();
    peer.await.unwrap();
    println!("MEASURE pages={pages} name_bytes=248 iterations={iterations} elapsed_ns={elapsed}");
}
